builders.angle: LITERAL -- the angle that won rounds 20 and 23-25. Work BRIEF-r29's fix list 1 to 3 in order and exactly as written, one wing at a time, the Sleeping Quarters FIRST (the lowest-scored and the judged fight). Keep every change inside your four wings and prove the other thirteen unchanged with the sweep.

THE OBJECT FIRST -- round 28's winning instinct. Each wing has one signature object the judges named: the iron beds, the carved statues, the glasshouse's ribs and bays, the clipped hedge. Draw each of those as a real object -- silhouette, material, contact shadow -- before anything else, then dress and light each room around it.

THE DARK AND THE AIR. Three of the four wings' complaints are haze and milk: the hedge's grey lawn, the dormitory's milky far wall, the Heart's hazy shafts, the greenhouse's teal glass. Take every haze out and bring every dark back down first, keeping the light only where the fighters stand; then build the objects in that light.
